items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: I'd go out there and take my solo and he'd come back and start some cracking

ctx.x: Just personal stuff. He was jealous. Jealous of me. I'd go out there and take my solo and he'd come back and start some cracking, you know, wise cracking, and I wouldn't take it. So I hit him with that guitar. And that's what started it. (Interruption)
That's right. So you get to know just what to do when you get ready to use it for some big money.
